modules.module_title: Prepare an appropriate venipuncture site for blood collection

pcs.pc_description: extend the patient's arm and inspect the ante-cubital fossa or forearm for locating a vein
ask the patient to form a fist so the veins are more prominent
locate a vein suitable for venipuncture with least chance of damaging an artery or a nerve
apply the tourniquet about 4-5 finger widths above the venipuncture site and re-examine the vein
clean the venipuncture site with isopropyl alcohol as per institutional guidelines

modules.module_title: Use correct techniques for blood collection

pcs.pc_description: anchor the vein by holding the patient's arm and placing a thumb below the venipuncture site
insert the needle as per the guidelines depending upon the type of device (straight or a winged) used for sample collection
enter the vein swiftly at an angle of less than/equal to 30-degrees
release the tourniquet when the blood starts flowing in the first tube or syringe
follow standard processes as appropriate to various types of samples collection such as order of draw, mixing of sample etc.
withdraw the needle gently and apply gentle pressure to the site with a clean gauze as per institutional guidelines
ask the patient to press the venipuncture site gently with a gauze, with the arm extended and raised
use appropriate equipment if required for difficult venous access
perform hand hygiene (if using soap and water, dry hands with single-use towels) and follow PPE protocols

ollow protocols for care following exposure to blood or other body fluids as required
remove spills in accordance with the policies and procedures of the organization
clean and dry all work surfaces with a neutral detergent and warm water solution before and after each session or when visibly soiled
demarcate and maintain clean and contaminated zones in all aspects of health care work
confine records, materials and medicaments to a welldesignated clean zone
confine contaminated instruments and equipment to a welldesignatedcontaminated zone
decontaminate equipment requiring special processing in accordance with quality management systems to ensure full compliance with cleaning, disinfection and sterilization protocols
replace surface covers where applicable
maintain and store cleaning equipment
report and deal with spillages and contamination in accordance with current legislation and procedures

pcs.pc_description: maintain hand hygiene following hand washing procedures before and after patient contact /or after any activity likely to cause contamination
cover cuts and abrasions with waterproof dressings and change as necessary
change protective clothing and gowns/aprons daily, more frequently if soiled and where appropriate, after each patient contact
perform additional precautions when standard precautions alone may not be sufficient to prevent transmission of infection
